title: KiCad Project Archive File Handling Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126971)
description: CVE-2026-126971 is a directory traversal vulnerability in KiCad's project archive file handling that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a malicious file or visiting a malicious page. The flaw arises from improper validation of user-supplied paths used in file operations, enabling code execution with the privileges of the current user.
